title: 2.7.8 Video — Drag and Release
description: Clicking is one-shot, but dragging follows the cursor across frames — and physics will fight you if you don't know the trick. This video shows the snap-and-zero-velocity pattern that makes a drag feel smooth before you code it yourself.
videoFallback: Teacher-recorded walkthrough. Ask your teacher for the YouTube link, or open the classroom slide deck for the live demo.
